about: The walk's cameras: one entry per stop (desktop 16:9 and phone 390x844, eye 1.65 m over the street or ground the visitor stands on, a level look with a shift lens), and the path, timed in seconds for the film. UTM metres and German-zero levels; a numeric y is a flight at that level.

stops.name: Over the moat to the North Gate
The forecourt and the whole double gate
A house and its tablets (House VI in Merkes)
The Nabu temple, how Babylon wrote
The great stair and the switch
The bridge over the Euphrates at sunset
The river and the year's first crescent

path.say: over the outer city at +45: the dam, the moat, the North Gate, the tower far off
lands on the dam, the North Gate ahead
cut: through the North Gate
cut: toward the end of the lion street
cut: inside the main gate
rises over the street south of the gate: the tower far off over the palace
drawing back as it rises, turning right
at +72: the vaulted building's block in the palace's north-east corner below, the North Palace on its terrace beyond, its edge terraces planted (guessed)
down past the corner by the gate, looking into the vaulted building's block
on the street: the palace's corner over the vaulted building, the gate beyond
on toward the terraces, banking left
over the palace roofs
over the court: the throne room, the tower above it
down into the court
the hold on the facade and its three doors
straight up: the tower again over the throne room
out east over the palace
over the canal where the street bridges it, no stop: the canal passes under the frame's foot
a low glide over the Merkes roofs toward House VI
down into House VI's court, eye 1.65 m over its paving, back in its north-west corner
up out of the court and back over the roofs toward the Nabu temple
cut to the street before the Nabu temple: its gate between two towers
in through the gate
through the vestibule
the hold in Nabu's court, the cella's door to the south
cut to the flight on toward the tower
down onto the street by the precinct wall
to Gate 5, turning right toward the tower
down the street south along the precinct wall
cut: at the precinct's south-east corner
the turn: the street west along the precinct's south side, Esagila far ahead on the left
cut: on the street by Gate 8, the open ground on the left
the hold: Esagila's north front across about 100 m of undug ground
on along the street to Gate 8
on the street where Esagila was seen, turning east along the precinct's south rooms
the turn north at the precinct's south gate: the tower through its passage
out of the passage: the tower's south face and its three stairs
the foot of the middle stair, its 6.2 m clear width
near the stair's head: above the first terrace the record has no stair, so the camera flies
the top's west side, into the last sun
on the top's platform at its west corner: the street north to the double gate, the river west
the turn west over the river
the bridge below, the next stop
the way down
on the street west of Gate 8, where the bridge's walk begins
cut: on the street west of Gate 8, the river and the bridge ahead
onto the deck over the east land pier
the hold over the river: the piers' points under the eye, the west bank's groves in the sun ahead
looks back, turning right through north
the tower over the quay, its west face in the last sun
on to Esagila and the quay south of the bridge
cut: on the deck an hour later, the sun gone, the river and the young crescent ahead over the west bank
the hold: the crescent low over the west bank, a little right of the deck, the water under the sky's last light

only.about: keys one tower state walks alone (bruegel-show/show-path.ts merges them into that state's path in place of the shared keys their span covers; every other state and tool reads `path` as it is)

bruegel-show.say: the showpiece only: up and back to the painter's own vantage, high and from the front, where his terraces, ramp and crowd show

waterClock.about: the river's ripple clock over a span of film seconds: it runs `seconds` across from..to, so the water after the span is as it was before stop 15 was put in (map.ts waterAt)
